title.narrative: China: Guangdong Social Security Integration and Rural Worker Training

description.narrative: The objective of the Project is to enhance portability of social security data and beneficiary entitlements, and to strengthen the skills base and employment prospects of urban and rural workers in Guangdong.

The objectives of the Guangdong Social Security Integration and Rural Worker Training Project for China are to enhance portability of social security data and beneficiary entitlements, and to strengthen the skills base and employment prospects of rural hukou workers in Guangdong. The project has two components. (1) Social security MIS component will invest into develop a new provincial Management of Information System (MIS) for Department for Human Resources and Social Security (DHRSS) which would serve to integrate data management across its major business lines (social insurance, employment services and HR management) and across the 21 prefectures in Guangdong province. The provincial MIS would provide for common data standards, information exchange through an integrated data sharing platform, coordination of social insurance benefits between prefectures for mobile beneficiaries\ who straddle more than one prefecture, and the decision support system to inform provincial DHRSS management. (2) Rural worker training component will invest in technical training institutions with a particular focus on short-term training needs of current and potential migrants for both entry level and upgrading of skills, supported by a strengthened set of services to support post-training placement. In addition, there will be a strong focus on deepening school-industry partnerships to enhance the labor market relevance of training. These emphases will enhance the relevance and skill-intensity of training to help fill skills gaps in Guangdong.

target.value: Light Industry: 1,400; Industry and Trade: 3,200; Yunfu: 1,600

comment.narrative:
<p>Achieved (exceeded the final targets)</p>
<p>The indicator to measure the of trainees for on-the-job training was introduced inthe 1st project restructuring. The 2015 baseline was adopted. In the 2nd project restructuring, the end target for Light Industry School was decreased from 1,500 to 1,400 and the end target for Yunfu School was increased from 300 to 1,600.</p>

actual.value: Light Industry: 3,444; Industry and Trade: 3,408; Yunfu: 2,159

title.narrative: Percentage of graduates finding initial employment (degree course)

baseline.value: Light Industry: 92%; Industry and Trade:98.4%; Yunfu:75%

target.value: Light Industry: 95%; Industry and Trade: 98.5%; Yunfu: 92.00%

comment.narrative:
<p>Achieved (exceeded the final targets)</p>
<p>In the 1st restructuring, the scope of trainees was expanded from those with rural hukou to all, regardless of hukou status; the baseline was updated to 2015, and the indicator values of degree graduates for two scools were added. For short-term training, the indicator includes in-school students and the new 2015 baseline was adopted. In the 2nd project restructuring, the end target for Yunfu School was decreased from 97.5% to 92%. This Indicator is no longer applicable to Yunfu School; the indicator was marked N/A.</p>

actual.value: Light Industry: 98.4%; Industry and Trade: 99.68%; Yunfu: 92.00%
